root_policy: Root is a navigation/index reference. Do not stuff all 13 pages into every prompt or omit exclusions to fit a budget.
main_fixture_strategy: Use exact prerequisite subsections with explicit false specialty-screen facts; retrieve complete applicable branch before invoking an exemption. Broad source remains available by ID.
unknown_or_specialty_strategy: Retrieve full relevant branch and its conditions/limitations. If not enough evidence fits in T05 bounded batches, applicability becomes needs_information and required evidence is marked incomplete; do not silently decide false.
chunking_contract: T05 keeps parent/child locator, raw source SHA256 and contiguous normalized text offsets. Exact subsection selection comes from source text, not generated summary.
